briefing.text: Information Technology stays #1 on all three sources. On News its buzz is 84.9 (-2.4 vs the day before, +2.4 over the week), mentions -6%, sentiment -0.2, led by NVDA, MSFT, AMD, AVGO and MU. On X it is 93.0 (-0.4, flat on the week, mentions -8%, sentiment 0.06); on Reddit 95.0 (+0.9, mentions +34%, sentiment -0.04). News fallers are Financials (78.1, -4.2 but +11.5 on the week; BAC, UBS, MS, GS, JPM) and Materials (77.5, -3.5, mentions -31%). The big jumps are small-ticker sectors: Healthcare on X rose 30.6 to 68.4 (mentions +2400%, MEDS and WWB) and on Reddit 17.3 to 63.8 (MEDS, VVVV); Technology on Reddit rose 23.7 to 55.4 (IDGAF) while falling 17.4 on X (DRK, IDGAF).

#1 BULL: earnings-call highlights record growth (tipranks), but Rosenblatt cut its target from $12 to $10; the news is mixed and only partly explains the rank.
#2 SILVER: one Benzinga piece says Asia's AI selloff is spilling into gold, silver and US tech; it fits the attention, but it is a single article.
#3 GOLD: "Does Gold Protect You When Stocks Fall?" plus the same Benzinga piece; 10 articles, which matches the high attention.
#4 UST30Y: Treasuries starting to hedge stocks again, and core inflation at 3.12% in September; explains the interest ahead of the Dec 9 FOMC.
#5 UST10Y: same Treasury-hedge and inflation stories as the 30Y; the news is shared, not specific.
#6 DJI: "Defensives Lead Sectors Friday As Growth Trails"; fits a market-wide rotation.
#7 NVDA: 845 articles, with Jensen Huang's departure the main theme; the stock is down 14% in 24h (4.6 sigma), which explains the rank more than attention does.
#8 ZM: previews ahead of earnings on Nov 23; explains the catalyst flag.

BULL is #1 (up from #18) mainly on strong attention percentiles (attention 98th, X attention 94th, volume 95th), a 2.7-sigma price move (-9.1% in 24h) and a Kalshi funded-accounts market. Its open interest is below normal, which did not hold it back. SILVER (#2) has the highest X attention of the top three (1.23 vs normal) with 192 X mentions, a 1.6-sigma drop of 4.1% and weak volume (0.54). GOLD (#3, up from #5) shows similar attention (1.09 on all sources, 1.04 on X) with 334 X and 63 Reddit mentions and a 1.9-sigma move. None of the three has a catalyst date inside two days, so all are T3; the attention weights (0.35 each for attention and X attention) drive the order.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
